description:
By the time you’re finished reading you’ll see that procrastination is not what you think…

…you can change it forever, and starting the life you really want is JUST around the corner.

There are 3 pieces:

Piece 1: What they didn’t teach us:

Procrastination is NOT the avoidance of a task, it is the avoidance of pain TRIGGERED by a task. 

You go to do something, it causes you to feel anxiety, stress, overwhelm. You shut down and distract yourself to escape the pain.

E.G. Someone pricks you with a needle, you flinch away. Obviously. The needle is the root cause. Procrastination is you flinching away. 

Piece 2: Break the cycle

If you do not remove the pain, you will never stop the procrastination.

Maybe the pain was you didn’t know where to start, and the uncertainty was stressful.

Or the stakes were high and you were afraid of failing, because failing again means you’ll never have the life you desperately want for yourself.

If you don’t find a way to minimise the pain, you will keep avoiding it—i.e. procrastinating.

Piece 3: How to transform everything

You can keep trying to transform your procrastination immediately, and fail for the rest of your life, OR

You can transform dramatically by taking a little bit of time to try to make things easier:

1. Look towards the pain. Figure out the source.
2. Experiment with ways of removing the pain.
3. Learn over time what works for you.
4. Only attempt tasks when you’ve minimised the pain (to break the habit of forcing that just makes the procrastination worse over time).

Conclusion: The permission slip

I give you permission to procrastinate the task until you have removed enough of the pain that the task feels light.

As long as you are taking time to learn about and solve the pain, you have permission to procrastinate the actual task until it’s light.

BECAUSE this is worth far more than one task. One deadline. This is about transforming EVERY task and deadline, for the rest of your life.

If you’re a student on a budget and you want to transform your procrastination permanently, type ‘FREE’ in the comments and I’ll hook you up (20 spots, two groups).

Or check my links to get in touch 💛
